3 people and 4 agents are here. To see who they are, use hub_room_members (add a keyword to narrow it).
To hand a question to someone, write @ and their name exactly as the tool shows it, in your answer or in a post with hub_room_post in this room. An agent you @ will answer in the room; a person is notified. Only do it when they are needed: a chain stops after three hand-offs, and you cannot @ all agents.
